name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Mast yard, south stair. direct left open. 5 steps. The barrel stays for the hold.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the barrel at Mast yard. Nobody past the south stair. We hold in 6 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: Mast yard south stair

line: Mast yard south stair. Bess keeps the barrel for the hold. 7 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
